name: Dreams in Darkness: Changeling Crossover Rules

pages.name: Dreams in Darkness: Changeling Crossover Rules

text.content:
Changelings remember Kindred as one of the fae's "Prodigal" races, but few Kindred remember changelings in turn. Aura Perception can sometimes reveal a changeling, but full perception of the Kithain and the Dreaming requires a Cainite to be magically enchanted — and once enchantment fades, the Mists of the Dreaming erase the memories of everyone involved except Malkavians, who are immune to the Mists.

Becoming Enchanted

  • A @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.antitribu.JournalEntry.gB6sZrC1J50lqpub]{Kiasyd} with Fae Sight (Mytherceria) is always considered enchanted.
  • A Cainite becomes enchanted if she freely accepts a token of enchantment offered by a changeling.
  • Feeding from a changeling (with the changeling's consent to the offer) also enchants a Cainite, and at Storyteller discretion may trigger hallucinations or derangements.
  • Malkavians who feed on changeling blood are cured of the effects of one derangement, but must win or tie a Simple Test against a Narrator to avoid developing an addiction to the vitae. A Cainite known to crave Kithain blood is rarely welcome in changeling freeholds.

Duration: enchantment normally lasts one day per Glamour Trait invested in a token, or one day per Blood Trait of changeling blood ingested (time spent in a changeling glade or freehold can extend this at Storyteller discretion). As long as at least one Trait of changeling blood remains in her system, the vampire can perceive chimerical reality.

Torpor on Disenchantment

When a Cainite's enchantment lapses back into mundane reality, or when she is slain by chimerical weapons, monsters, or magic, she normally falls into torpor for a duration based on her Banality (up to two months for most Kindred). She can avoid this torpor by spending a Willpower Trait when enchantment fades — Malkavians never need to spend this Trait; they automatically avoid the torpor. If a Cainite is slain chimerically, she is simply "out for the count" per the changeling core rules, regardless of Willpower spent.

Banality Ratings

Kindred are undead and mentally rigid, which usually means high Banality – dangerous to changelings and lethal to their chimerical companions:

  • @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.oWsHHlI3OS7cwvaF]{Ravnos}: 6 Traits of Banality.
  • Mortals: 6-7 Traits.
  • Other Kindred, including Kiasyd: 8-9 Traits.

Storytellers may adjust these for factors like unusually high Humanity, Path ratings, or a young vampire's relative closeness to mortal life. A changeling who is foolish enough to drink Cainite vitae can become a ghoul (or even blood bound) and gains one Trait of temporary Banality per Cainite Blood Trait ingested. A changeling who spends an hour in the company of ten or more Kindred may be assigned one Trait of temporary Banality per hour, at Storyteller discretion.

Discipline Interactions

  • Mytherceria (Fae Sight): Lets Kiasyd see and interact with changelings and chimerical reality directly.
  • Chimerstry: Illusions remain as incidental chimera even after they fade from mundane perception. Sluagh can attempt to pierce Chimerstry illusions using Sharpened Senses plus a Mental Challenge.
  • Aura Perception: On a changeling, shows a distinctive bright, flickering-colored aura. High Auspex can counter Chicanery the same way Auspex counters Obfuscate.
  • Obfuscate: Affects most changelings normally. Sluagh may pierce it with Sharpened Senses plus a Mental Challenge.

Combat

Kindred claws and teeth inflict aggravated damage on changelings. In turn, any cantrip that inflicts direct damage (such as Holly Strike) inflicts aggravated damage on a vampire, working exactly like any other source of aggravated damage.
